title: October 31, 1875: a boy was born in Gujarat who would later talk over 500 separate kingdoms into joining one country.

sources.text: News on Air - PM Modi to participate in Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations in Gujarat
National Today - Rashtriya Ekta Diwas / National Unity Day

caption:
October 31, 1875: a boy was born in Gujarat who would later talk over 500 separate kingdoms into joining one country.

He is credited with the political integration of more than 500 princely states into the Indian Union after independence - a negotiation that determined the literal shape of the country on a map.

2026 marks his 151st birth anniversary and closes a two-year nationwide commemorative programme that began with his 150th anniversary in 2025, centred at the Statue of Unity in Gujarat.

Nearly 80 years on, the map he helped draw through persuasion rather than conquest is the same one the country is still building on.
